svg.aria-label: A small rack computer on a plinth. At the top, a card reader holds five punched cards reading 'the cat sat on the', with one empty slot. Five bus lanes run down a backplane, and four layer boards plug into it; on each board, traces tie the last word's chip back to the chips of the earlier words, thicker where it pays more attention. The last lane runs on to a scoring chip on the deck, and six traces run from it down to an LED bar meter on the front panel, one bar per candidate word. Under the bars, an LED strip lays out the odds; a random-number chip on the ledge sets a cursor on it, and a punch cuts the chosen word onto a card that goes back up into the reader.
